dave-sales: On a quick demo call with Jen from FinCorp 1. They hit a burst and we started returning 503s. Can we triage fast?
tyler-support: What timeframe/request id?
dave-sales: req_c9d8e7f6 at 2026-03-22T11:05:12Z. They ramped from ~200rps to ~1.6krps.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] autoscaler event: scale-up requested 2026-03-22T11:05:14Z, provision_delay=20s.
maria-eng: Quick check: worker OOM during a long-context request (2.8k tokens) -> router queue exceeded threshold -> gateway returned 503 after retries. Short mitigations: apply temporary concurrency cap (70%), enable fallback to compact model, and pre-warm kv-cache.
tyler-support: Applying concurrency cap and enabling fallback now.
maria-eng: Routing change done.
jen-customer: Errors dropped, thanks. Slightly higher latency but usable.
dave-sales: Customer wants two things: (1) confirmation that full prompt text isn't stored persistently, (2) price for a short reserved node for the POC week.
nina-security: We do not store full prompt text in persistent logs by default. We can provide a sanitized log bundle and a short attestation.
maria-eng: Pricing for a demo reserved N4 node: $900/day or $4,200 for 5 days. Reserved node plus concurrency cap should prevent these 5xxs for typical usage.
dave-sales: Great, I will send the attestation and pricing. Tyler, upload sanitized logs and the attestation to the deal thread.
tyler-support: Uploaded. Closing loop; monitoring for 24h.
